title: Illinois Residential Real Property Disclosure Report
description: 765 ILCS 77 requires sellers of residential property to complete the state-mandated disclosure report before accepting an offer. Buyer has 5 business days to rescind.

required_actions.note: Must be provided before offer is accepted. Buyer may rescind within 5 business days.

title: Illinois Radon Awareness Disclosure
description: Illinois Radon Awareness Act requires sellers to provide the IEMA radon disclosure pamphlet and disclose known radon tests, results, or mitigation systems.

title: Attorney Review Period
description: Illinois contracts include a 5-business-day attorney review period following contract execution during which either party's attorney may modify, approve, or reject the contract.

required_actions.note: 5 business days from execution. Standard in Chicago/collar-county contracts.
